race.comment: IT IS TO BE (2) drifted well back last start before winding up strongly to finish third over 2000m at Wagga. Well placed and can strike through this time. HEAPY'S LEGACY (3) did well to score two runs ago then turned in a nice run last time out when fifth over 2100m at Tamworth, only beaten 1.75 lengths. Best figures measure up and is a genuine winning hope again. LONE STAR DREAM (5) has a moderate winning strike rate but performed well last time at Tamworth, finishing third and only half a length from the winner at the end of 2100m after being in contention on the turn. Looks well placed so expecting another big run. GODWITS (1) dug deep to score two runs back then couldn't threaten at Louth last time a month ago. Mixing his form but is worth keeping safe for a spot in the frame.
